acceptedAnswer.text: Content marketing is publishing useful articles, guides, video and email that answer your buyers' questions, so they find you, trust you and enquire or buy.

mainEntity.name: How is content marketing different from SEO?

acceptedAnswer.text: SEO is the technical and structural work that makes content findable. Content marketing is the planning and making of the content itself. They work best together, and we run them as one plan.
Articles, guides, comparison pages, case studies, short video, email and WhatsApp series, and social posts cut from the same topics. We pick formats by the job, not by habit.

mainEntity.name: Will content marketing bring leads quickly?

acceptedAnswer.text: Usually not. Content compounds over months. If you need leads this month, paid media can run alongside while content builds. No. Nobody can honestly guarantee a ranking, a review or a timeline. We commit to the work in the monthly scope and report what we can observe.

A monthly scope, agreed after a call and written down so you can see what each month covers. We do not publish a price list because the right scope depends on your site, your market and how much you want done.

Brands whose buyers research before buying. We work with D2C, B2B and education brands and set the work up differently for each. D2C: product education and reviews. B2B: specifications, comparisons and proof. Education: course, fee and admission questions.

mainEntity.name: What do you need from us?

acceptedAnswer.text: Access to someone who knows the product or course well, your sales and support questions, brand guidelines, and a named approver. We do the research and drafting.

answer.label: In short
answer.lead: Content marketing is the practice of publishing useful articles, guides, video and email that answer your buyers' questions, so they find you, trust you and enquire or buy. It is planned around search and the buying journey, not around what is easiest to post, and judged by qualified traffic and enquiries.
answer.who: Monday Marketing Company (MMC) plans and produces content for D2C, B2B and education brands, connected to our SEO, social and paid work.

points.title: Linked to the funnel

paras: Content that exists only to fill a calendar rarely earns anything. Content that answers a real question at the right moment can be found in search, quoted in AI answers, forwarded inside a buying committee and reused in ads and emails.
So we start with the question and the reader, then pick the format. The same research feeds SEO, AEO and social media.

stages.why: Content that tries to suit every reader answers no one's real question.
stages.does: We define the buyers, their questions and the stage they are at, then choose topics that matter to the business.

stages.why: Irregular publishing wastes the research and cannot be measured.
stages.does: We set a calendar by topic cluster, with owners, formats and dates. See social media.

stages.breaks: Thin posts that repeat what everyone says.
stages.why: Search and AI tools have little reason to surface content that adds nothing.
stages.does: We write with specifics: your method, your product knowledge and examples, edited for accuracy.

stages.k: Make it in the right format
stages.why: Some answers read best as text, others as a short clip or an email.
stages.does: We cut the same idea into the formats buyers use, with video from our UGC and video team.

stages.why: Content nobody sees earns nothing, and nobody learns what works.
stages.does: We push content through search, social, email and paid, and report on qualified traffic, enquiries and orders.
